name: Warsong clan
summary: Across Kalimdor, the Warsong clan cuts timber for the young Horde. Once led by the revered chieftain Grommash Hellscream, the clan endured exile, internment camps, and demonic corruption. Now its Outriders work chiefly in Ashenvale, where they clash ceaselessly with the night elves.

sections.title: A Legacy of Defiance
sections.body: On Draenor's open plains, the Warsong earned their name through swift attacks by wolf riders. After the Horde fell, the clan evaded capture while other orcs languished in Alliance internment camps. The Warsong wandered the wilderness and kept to their warlike ways. At last, Thrall united with Hellscream, and together they forged the New Horde.

sections.title: Blood and Redemption
sections.body:
During the Third War, the Warsong reached Kalimdor. Thrall sent Hellscream and his clan into Ashenvale to cut timber and build an outpost. Their intrusion enraged the night elves and the forest demigod Cenarius. Facing slaughter, the Warsong drank once more from Mannoroth's demonic blood and killed Cenarius in a frenzy of fel corruption.

Thrall and his allies purged Hellscream of the curse. Grom then gave his life in a fateful fight that destroyed Mannoroth. His sacrifice broke the demon blood curse forever and secured the Warsong's place in Horde history.

sections.title: The War for Ashenvale
sections.body: Today, the Warsong Outriders carry on Grommash's mission in Ashenvale. From Splintertree Post and logging camps, they cut timber for the young Horde in Durotar's arid wastes. Their presence has brought them into bitter conflict with the night elven Silverwing Sentinels. The Warsong hold Warsong Gulch and keep cutting into the ancient forest despite the endless ambushes.

faq.q: Who leads the Warsong clan right now?
faq.answer: Since Grommash Hellscream died at the end of the Third War, the Warsong clan has largely joined Thrall's New Horde. In the field, Warsong Outriders in Ashenvale answer to local commanders and ultimately to Warchief Thrall.

faq.q: Why are the Warsong logging in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The New Horde is based in the arid plains of Durotar and the Barrens, where substantial timber is scarce. The Warsong gather lumber in Ashenvale to build cities such as Orgrimmar, maintain military fortifications, and support the growing Horde.

faq.q: How did the Warsong kill Cenarius?
faq.answer: During the Third War, Cenarius led the night elves in a fierce defense of Ashenvale and drove the Warsong to desperation. The clan drank from a pool tainted with the blood of the pit lord Mannoroth. The blood made them demon-maddened chaos orcs, whose empowered fury overwhelmed and killed Cenarius.

faq.q: How did the Warsong escape the internment camps after the Second War?
faq.answer: After the Second War, Grommash Hellscream and the Warsong hid in Lordaeron's remote wilderness and evaded Alliance capture. They waged guerrilla warfare and kept their fighting spirit until Thrall found them.

Warsong Gulch is a canyon valley in southern Ashenvale, where the Warsong Outriders clash with the night elven Silverwing Sentinels. The Outriders fight to protect their lumber operations, while the Sentinels seek to drive the orcs from their sacred woodland.

Grommash 'Grom' Hellscream was the legendary Warsong chieftain and a mentor to Thrall. He was the first orc to drink demon blood on Draenor, but later redeemed himself by slaying Mannoroth and freeing all orcs from demonic bondage. He gave his life in the deed.

angles.text: For orcs, the Warsong carry both their people's deepest shame and greatest redemption. They were the first to drink Mannoroth's blood, and their chieftain died to break the demon's hold over all orcs.
The night elves hate the Warsong for cutting sacred Ashenvale woodlands and killing the demigod Cenarius.
The New Horde depends on timber the Warsong Outriders cut in Ashenvale to fortify settlements and expand across Kalimdor.
To many in the Alliance, the Warsong's relentless aggression shows that peace between the factions remains impossible while their axes swing in Ashenvale.
